name: STC31 (SparkFun)
description: The STC3x sensor family is Sensirion’s series of Gas Concentration sensors designed for high-volume applications. The STC3x utilizes a revolutionized thermal conductivity measurement principle, which results in superior repeatability and long-term stability. This make the STC31 a perfect choice for applications where reliability is key. Imported from the SparkFun KiCad library (CC-BY-4.0, attribution: SparkFun Electronics); passed PartReel quality gates.
